weekPattern.purpose: New (or next) scene: blind listen, glue, three chunks, AI role-play.
Same theme a little faster, then short 4/3/2.
Shadow a short dialogue already understood. In Packs 1–3 this is still daily/travel register; Pack 4 uses the original TV-register scenes.
Narrow listen with another voice, then a three-sentence reaction. Lower load, same life.
Rebuild 20–40 seconds, then say the rebuilt version out loud.
Second role-play day in the pack, a new twist on the same theme.

gapRule: The app, not this file, decides the comeback warmup. If a learner has been away, play warmupFrom (or the previous scene in the pack) for about 20 seconds before the day's scene. These warmupFrom fields mark useful anchors: start of each pack, dictogloss days, and the contrast session.

sessions.titleZh: 先看看你现在能抓住什么
sessions.note: Three familiar-topic listens at about 120, 150, and 180 wpm (gist + detail), then 30 seconds to prepare and about 45 seconds of talk about something from this week. There is no fail. The app uses this to place the learner on the rate ladder and to seed the first feedback line.
New scene, blind listen, glue, three chunks, then role-play.

sessions.titleEn: Same money talk, a little faster
sessions.note: Slightly faster version of the same life. Short 4/3/2 on who paid.
No TV-register scene in this pack; shadow this daily dialogue anyway. Then a short variant role-play if there is time.
Easy narrow listen: a server joins, same money language, another voice. Three-sentence reaction at the end.
Dictogloss lite on a 20–40 second stretch (forgot my wallet / I'll get you back), then say the rebuilt version out loud.
Second role-play day: make the promised 'next one' actually happen.
Close the pack with 4/3/2 on the three-way split.

sessions.titleZh: 今日一场戏：我要晚到了
sessions.note: New pack, same two friends. Soft apology plus a real time.
4/3/2 on being on the way and asking someone to get a table.
Shadow the rain dialogue, then a short variant if there is time.
Easy narrow listen: same rain day, the first cafe is packed. Three-sentence reaction.
Dictogloss on the long function-word stretch: I don't want you to feel like you have to / wanna just do it tomorrow.
Role reversal of day 1. Recycle you're fine.
4/3/2 on pushing the time and naming a backup.

Replace the usual main activity with the biweekly contrast: re-listen to the same 150 wpm diagnostic from session 0 (gist + one detail, no text first), then a 60-45-30 on a recent change of plans, using pack02-05 as the prompt. Compare, in plain language, to the first-day listen and the first speaking sample. This is not a test score.

sessions.titleZh: 今日一场戏：我在门口了
sessions.note: Travel pack begins. Human driver, not a scripted clerk.
4/3/2 retelling the stranger's directions from memory.
Shadow the hotel check-in, then a short variant (wrong number of nights, extra key).
Easy narrow listen: another stranger, same getting-around world.
Dictogloss on can you drop me at the corner / here's fine, actually / let me out here.

sessions.titleEn: Role-play: is this the right stop?
sessions.note: Role-play asking if this is the right stop.
4/3/2 on the room not being ready.

sessions.titleEn: Today's scene: I'll do the burger
sessions.titleZh: 今日一场戏：我就来这个汉堡
sessions.note: Food pack begins. Ordering with a human server.
4/3/2 on what the server recommended and what got changed.
Daily-register wrong order, role-play first, so the later TV version has something to lean on.

sessions.titleEn: Easy listen: I'm allergic to peanuts
sessions.note: Easy listen, but the allergy content has to stay precise. Three-sentence reaction, no jokes about the allergy itself.
Dictogloss on the kitchen's a little backed up / how long are we talking / you wanna wait, or.

sessions.titleEn: TV shadow: we could just share
sessions.titleZh: 剧场风跟读：要不然就拼一份
sessions.note: First real TV-register scene in Month 1. Blind listen, glue, then shadow. Variant role-play if there is time.

sessions.titleEn: TV shadow: this is not what I ordered
sessions.titleZh: 剧场风跟读：这不是我点的那个
sessions.note: Second TV-register scene, same food-help theme, slightly faster. Shadow, then a short messy variant.
